semantics: Literal fictional preconditions and independently written expected outcomes. Allow means the proposed paper contract admits that example after all omitted ordinary conditions are assumed valid; no implementation was executed and no token, membership or authority was created. Explicitly changed denial conditions are decisive. Synthetic verification results are test stipulations, never browser assertions accepted by a real verifier.

criteria.title: Specify trusted membership provisioning boundaries
criteria.acceptance: For optional operator-approved adoption: A design records which backend creates memberships, who can approve assignments and how client-controlled role fields are ignored.

criteria.title: Define optional custom-token issuer contract
criteria.acceptance: For optional operator-approved adoption: The contract requires trusted issuer identity, audience, lifetime and scope while keeping token generation outside browser code.

criteria.title: Define optional portal-specific permission bundles
criteria.acceptance: For optional operator-approved adoption: A reviewed design groups CMS publication, CRM assignment and HR administration capabilities without deriving them solely from paid account level.

criteria.title: Design optional session step-up requirements
criteria.acceptance: For optional operator-approved adoption: An adoption matrix identifies which sensitive export or owner action should require recent authentication and leaves enforcement disabled until reviewed.
